description:
The image depicts two elephants engaged in a fierce battle, their trunks entwined as they face off in a grassy field. The larger elephant, situated on the left side of the image, has its trunk wrapped around the smaller elephant's neck, while the smaller elephant, positioned on the right side, has its trunk grasping the larger elephant's ear. The elephants' bodies are turned towards each other, with their heads facing forward.

In the background, a tree and a pole are visible
